items.title: the CORTIS "GO!" dance tutorial
items.creator: @cortis_bighit
items.body: the k-pop group CORTIS posted a step-by-step tutorial for their "GO!" choreo, one move at a time, and it has 27.6M views. everyone is learning it.

items.title: everyone is hunting the Fortnite Pirate Token
items.body: the #piratetoken hashtag is at 138.9M views and still climbing, all clips of people finding (or almost finding) a secret Fortnite token. the kids are OBSESSED.

items.title: the one-pair-of-jeans fit check
items.creator: @j0y.s0phie
items.body: one pair of jeans, a bunch of mirror poses, 13.4M views. it's so simple and it's working!!

items.title: "aura farming"
items.body: doing little things on purpose to rack up "aura points." holding the door = plus aura. tripping in front of everyone = minus aura.

items.title: "side quest"
items.body: borrowed from video games: any small detour from your plans. stopping for a coffee on the way to a meeting is a side quest.

items.title: "lowkenuinely"
items.body: low-key + genuinely. it's how you say an honest opinion without making it a whole thing. "lowkenuinely that was good."

items.title: "Zalphas"
items.body: the kids born right on the line between gen z and gen alpha, roughly late 2000s to mid 2010s. Claire's CMO helped make the term mainstream.
